# wget

Download HTTP and HTTPS resources through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/wget https://example.com/

moonx cli/wget -O page.html https://example.com/

moonx cli/wget -c https://example.com/archive.tar
```

Save downloads to named files by default. Supports URL lists, redirects, Basic authentication, cookies, retries, resume and timestamp selection.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | quiet (no output) Default: `false`. |
| `-O VALUE`, `--output-document VALUE` | write documents to FILE |
| `-i VALUE`, `--input-file VALUE` | download URLs found in FILE |
| `-c`, `--continue` | resume after the already written prefix Default: `false`. |
| `-N`, `--timestamping` | do not re-retrieve unchanged files Default: `false`. |
| `-t VALUE`, `--tries VALUE` | set number of retries (0 means unlimited) Default: `20`. |
| `--load-cookies VALUE` | load a Netscape cookie jar |
| `--save-cookies VALUE` | save persistent cookies |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

- FTP, recursive mirroring, HSTS and complete upstream configuration/IRI behavior are unsupported.
- Authentication replay cannot rewind stdin request bodies. Multiple failures retain the lowest nonzero Wget status; partial files can remain after errors.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
